question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility alias, and which legacy helper names are in scope before this PR merges?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but restoring or narrowing a shipped PluginRuntime API compatibility surface is a maintainer-owned contract decision.

options.title: Land Scoped Alias
options.body: After resolving the dirty branch, accept this object-identical `turn` alias for the four inbound-shaped helpers and keep `inbound` canonical for new plugins.

options.title: Restore Full Legacy Object
options.body: Require additional aliases for historical names such as `runPrepared`, `runAssembled`, `runResolved`, and `dispatchAssembled` before merge.

options.title: Reject Core Alias
options.body: Require affected plugins to publish updates to `channel.inbound.*` instead of re-expanding the core runtime surface.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Alias
recommendation.body: After resolving the dirty branch, accept this object-identical `turn` alias for the four inbound-shaped helpers and keep `inbound` canonical for new plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior appears to date to steipete's removal commit, so this is the best available owner for deciding the deprecation/compatibility scope.
